A small display fix for the System panel.

## Fixed

- **Doubled "v" in the qBittorrent version** shown in the System panel (e.g.
  `vv5.2.3`). qBittorrent's version string already includes a leading `v`, so the
  health check no longer adds its own — it now shows `v5.2.3`.

## Docker

```
docker pull ghcr.io/dyonng/one-pace-plex-automator:1.1.14
```
